operating_mode.input: You take in the world mainly as material to master, not as things to react to. A new regulation, a client's odd requirement, a technical standard — your instinct is to open the source documents yourself and trace the rules to the origin, then keep going past the point anyone asked for. The lead force here is Indirect Resource — the month stem Wu earth carries it openly, and it also hides in the month branch Yin, the day branch Chen, and the hour branch Si — so intake works best when it is solitary and deep. You also take in demands: Seven Killings hides in Yin and Si, so pressure arrives as hard external requirements rather than invitations, and you absorb it instead of deflecting it.
operating_mode.processing: Processing happens privately and serially. You convert a hard demand into a research question, withdraw, and study until you understand the mechanism better than the person who set the demand. The balanced Geng day master, favoring metal and earth, is fed by that heavy Indirect Resource rather than flooded by it, so this digestion genuinely recharges you instead of draining you. Meetings are not where your thinking happens; your personal notes and reference files are. Months later you can pull the exact clause while others search their inboxes. The weakness on this side: the eating-god channel sits empty and Hurting Officer is barely present, so processing ends in banked understanding, not shared conclusions.
operating_mode.output: Output is the narrow gate in this system. Eating God sits at zero and Hurting Officer at two, and the visible eight characters contain no water — so almost nothing you learn flows outward on its own. What does come out comes in two forms: precise answers when someone asks you directly, and traceable results — a system you maintain, a client that keeps renewing — which is the Direct Wealth side speaking, carried openly by the year stem Yi wood and hidden in the day branch Chen. Colleagues see your competence mainly when a crisis forces it out, and credit often goes to whoever spoke first. Without a deliberate artifact — a document, a demo, a talk — your mastery leaves no public trace.
operating_mode.recovery: You recharge through solitary contact with source material. A quiet evening tracing rules leaves you more settled than a full team celebration does — Indirect Resource at ten is your main intake, and using it genuinely restores you, which is unusual and worth trusting. The reverse also holds: fragmented days of constant interruption starve your recharge channel while Seven Killings' demands pile up undischarged, and you end the day tired without having done visible work. Guard research time as recovery time, not as work you should apologize for. From around age thirty-eight the Ren-Wu pillar introduces water — the element your visible chart lacks — making writing, teaching, and demonstrating unusually low-effort outlets in that stretch.

failure_environments.env: A workplace where the fastest voice wins and credit is allocated by self-promotion among peers.
failure_environments.mechanism: Rob Wealth sits joint-heaviest beside Direct Wealth — the hour stem Xin metal plus a hidden stem in the year branch Chou on one side, the year stem Yi wood plus a hidden stem in the day branch Chen on the other. When colleagues openly race for the same credit, your loop short-circuits at its narrowest segment: you master something privately, the near-empty output channel produces no public trace, and a peer presents your conclusion as theirs. Your steady accumulation then converts into pure defense — energy spent guarding ground instead of building it — and because Direct Wealth keeps your position and finances stable, nothing looks broken from outside while the engine runs well below its capacity.

failure_environments.env: Constant interruption, shallow multitasking, and days sliced into fragments.
failure_environments.mechanism: Indirect Resource at ten is the heaviest force in this chart, and it feeds you only through long, uninterrupted contact with source material. Fragmented days block your main recharge channel at the intake end — the deep dives never start — while Seven Killings' hidden pressure in Yin and Si keeps arriving as hard demands. Pressure with no processing and no expression is the loop's worst state: you absorb demands you cannot discharge, finish days depleted with nothing banked, and the settled feeling that normally follows a deep dive never comes. The failure is silent because each individual interruption looks harmless.

failure_environments.env: A role whose value is decided by rapid, visible external action rather than verified depth.
failure_environments.mechanism: The chart's output channel — Hurting Officer at two, water absent from the visible characters — cannot sustain continuous public performance. A role demanding daily improvisation, persuasion, and live judgment drains the balanced Geng day master without the metal-and-earth support that solitary research provides. Your strengths, tracing rules to source and holding traceable ground, produce nothing measurable in such settings, so both innate talents — private deep-dive research and steady accumulation — idle while you simulate a working style the structure does not run on.

ideal_life_structure.time: Block most of the week into long, protected deep-work stretches — mornings or whole days where nobody can reach you — and concentrate meetings into one or two fixed slots. Your processing is serial and solitary: Indirect Resource at ten means a three-hour unbroken session accomplishes more than a week of scattered hours. Evenings with source material count as recovery, not overtime, so schedule them without guilt. From around age thirty-eight, with water entering via the Ren-Wu pillar, add a recurring writing or teaching slot — the same protected format, pointed outward.
ideal_life_structure.collaboration: Low density, high specificity. You work best with a small circle of trusted counterparts rather than large fluid teams: one or two collaborators whose roles are defined exactly — because Rob Wealth runs as heavy as Direct Wealth, undefined splits with peers trigger your defensive ground-guarding and burn energy in negotiation. Asynchronous collaboration suits you better than constant live coordination: written handoffs, clear ownership boundaries, and a stated consequence if a partner underdelivers. Be the person who owns a defined domain end-to-end, not one of many hands on a shared task.
ideal_life_structure.feedback_cycle: You need long measurement windows with objective milestones, not weekly mood-based evaluations. Your loop runs pressure → private study → held ground, and the middle stage takes months; a monthly or quarterly review against traceable results — documents delivered, systems kept stable, clients renewed — matches how your work actually matures. Real-time feedback loops meant for improvisers misread you as slow. Pair each long cycle with one short visible checkpoint: a short writeup or demo at the end of every deep dive, so outsiders can see progress while the long window is still running.
ideal_life_structure.income_rhythm: Steady, predictable inflows with a fixed savings routine match your natural design. Direct Wealth — carried openly by the year stem Yi wood and hidden in the day branch Chen — builds wealth bit by bit: salary lands, a fixed portion moves to savings before spending, renewals and maintenance contracts compound quietly. You are not built for income that depends on frequent public pitching or high-stakes volatility spikes, because the near-empty output channel cannot support a constant sales posture. Supplementary income that flows from artifacts — a course, a reference guide, a retained advisory built on your notes — fits the age-thirty-eight window well.

stability_vs_volatility.verdict: Stable at the base, with one deliberately chosen high-expression layer on top.
stability_vs_volatility.reason: The structure itself argues for stability. The Geng day master is balanced and favors metal and earth; Direct Wealth is joint-heaviest, describing income and ground accumulated steadily; Rob Wealth at the same weight means every volatile, contested arena costs you defense energy without raising your return. A high-variance life — commission-only income, startup swings, roles won by self-promotion — hits both weak points at once: it demands continuous output through the channel you barely have, and it drops you into peer contests that trigger ground-guarding. But pure stability has its own trap: with output nearly absent and water missing from the visible characters, a fully settled life lets your banked mastery stay invisible forever, and the ceiling is set by whoever speaks. So the base — position, savings, domain ownership — should be stable; the variable part should be chosen expression, not chosen risk.
stability_vs_volatility.precondition: The stable base only serves you if the expression layer is installed on top of it: one visible artifact — a short document, a demo, a talk — attached to every deep dive, so your name sits on your understanding. Without that habit, stability quietly becomes a cage where Direct Wealth keeps everything comfortable while nothing you know is credited. The Ren-Wu pillar from around age thirty-eight is the lowest-effort window in decades to build this, because water is the one element your visible chart lacks and it carries knowledge outward. Choose a stable environment that rewards verified depth — documents, audit trails, standards — never one that rewards the loudest voice.

environment_checklist: Does this place decide trust by traceable results — documents, standards, audit trails, renewals — rather than by who presents fastest and loudest? If visibility is allocated by self-promotion contests among peers, your loop leaks at the output segment and your energy converts to defense. Yes is required.

Can I protect long, uninterrupted deep-work blocks — whole mornings or days — as a normal, sanctioned part of this role? If the culture fragments time into constant status check-ins and live pings, your recharge channel blocks and pressure accumulates undischarged. Yes is required.

Are ownership boundaries with collaborators defined in writing — who owns which part, and what happens if someone underdelivers? Vague 'we'll figure it out' splits activate your ground-guarding reflex and drain energy into negotiation. Yes is required.

Is the feedback cycle measured in months against verifiable milestones, rather than weekly impressions? Your work matures through long private study; short mood-based evaluations will systematically misread you as slow before your results surface. Yes is strongly preferred.

Is the income mostly steady — salary, retainers, renewals — rather than dependent on frequent pitching or volatility? And if a variable component exists, does it flow from artifacts I produce, like writing or teaching, rather than from live persuasion? Yes to the first, and preferably yes to the second, is required.
